hooks.command: sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks/format-file.cjs" ]; do d=${d%/*}; done; [ -n "$d" ] || exit 0; node "$d/.codex/hooks/format-file.cjs"'

sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks/codex-guard.cjs" ]; do d=${d%/*}; done; node "$d/.codex/hooks/codex-guard.cjs" shell; s=$?; [ $s = 0 ] || [ $s = 2 ] || { echo "[BLOCKED] The blit386 guard could not run, so the request was blocked." >&2; s=2; }; exit $s'

sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks/codex-guard.cjs" ]; do d=${d%/*}; done; node "$d/.codex/hooks/codex-guard.cjs" patch; s=$?; [ $s = 0 ] || [ $s = 2 ] || { echo "[BLOCKED] The blit386 guard could not run, so the request was blocked." >&2; s=2; }; exit $s'
sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks/session-start.sh" ]; do d=${d%/*}; done; [ -n "$d" ] || exit 0; cd "$d" && BLIT_PM_INSTALL="pnpm install" sh .codex/hooks/session-start.sh'
